cases.question: 2025年11月净销售额是多少？请给精确到分的元数。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount)/100.0,2) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND u.is_test=0 AND o.order_time LIKE '2025-11%'

cases.question: 2025年12月净销售额是多少？请给精确到分的元数。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount)/100.0,2) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND u.is_test=0 AND o.order_time LIKE '2025-12%'

cases.question: 2025年11月GMV是多少元？按已支付订单口径，包含后来全额退款的订单。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount)/100.0,2) FROM orders o JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed','refunded') AND u.is_test=0 AND o.order_time LIKE '2025-11%'

cases.question: 2025年12月退款率是多少？请说明分母。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS refund_rate FROM orders o JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed','refunded') AND u.is_test=0 AND o.order_time LIKE '2025-12%'
required_patterns: 已支付|支付订单|paid.*completed.*refunded

cases.question: 2025年12月有效订单的客单价是多少元？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount)*1.0/COUNT(*)/100.0,2) FROM orders o JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND u.is_test=0 AND o.order_time LIKE '2025-12%'

cases.question: 2025年12月月活用户数是多少？按行为日志而不是订单统计。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) FROM user_events e JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.is_test=0 AND e.event_date LIKE '2025-12%'

cases.question: 2025全年新注册的非测试用户数是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE is_test=0 AND register_date LIKE '2025%'

cases.question: 2025年11月华东净销售额多少元？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount)/100.0,2) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND u.is_test=0 AND o.order_time LIKE '2025-11%' AND u.region_code='EAST'

cases.question: 2025年12月有效订单数是多少？排除测试账号。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND u.is_test=0 AND o.order_time LIKE '2025-12%'

cases.question: 2025全年按明细成交额计算，销售额最高的商品名称和金额分别是什么？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name,ROUND(SUM(i.item_amount)/100.0,2) FROM orders o JOIN users u USING(user_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) JOIN categories c USING(category_id) WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND u.is_test=0 GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 比较2025年11月和12月净销售额，给两个周期金额及变化。使用整体维度并核对总量。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time LIKE '2025-11%' THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END)/100.0,2),ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time LIKE '2025-12%' THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END)/100.0,2) FROM orders o JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND u.is_test=0

cases.question: 比较2025年11月与12月净销售额，按区域拆解，指出绝对下降额最大的区域。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name FROM orders o JOIN users u USING(user_id) JOIN regions r USING(region_code) WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND u.is_test=0 GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time LIKE '2025-12%' THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time LIKE '2025-11%' THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END) LIMIT 1

cases.question: 比较2025年11月和12月净销售额，按下单渠道拆解，找绝对下降额最大的渠道。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.channel FROM orders o JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND u.is_test=0 GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time LIKE '2025-12%' THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time LIKE '2025-11%' THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END) LIMIT 1

cases.question: 比较2025年11月和12月家用电器的品类明细销售额，给两个周期金额，使用整体维度。
